claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Mesna is a thiol antioxidant/uroprotective agent that at 2.5 uM is not expected to kill cancer cells directly; any apparent activity would reflect nonspecific thiol reactivity or antioxidant effects rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
